units.title: 问候与预约 · 情景对话

items.prompt: Good afternoon. Welcome to the Harbor Hotel. How may I help you?
items.answer: Good afternoon. Welcome to the Harbor Hotel. How may I help you?

hints.zh: 下午好，欢迎来到海港酒店。有什么可以帮您？
hints.en: The receptionist welcomes the guest and offers help.
hints.ja: 受付係が客を迎え、用件を尋ねます。

items.hint: 下午好，欢迎来到海港酒店。有什么可以帮您？ / The receptionist welcomes the guest and offers help. / 受付係が客を迎え、用件を尋ねます。

dialogueTitles.ja: ホテルの予約チェックイン

dialogueScenes.zh: 女前台为有预约的男宾客办理入住。
dialogueScenes.en: A female receptionist checks in a male guest with a reservation.
dialogueScenes.ja: 女性の受付係が予約済みの男性客のチェックインを担当します。

items.prompt: Hello. I have a reservation under the name Daniel Lee.
items.answer: Hello. I have a reservation under the name Daniel Lee.

hints.zh: 您好，我用丹尼尔·李的名字订了房。
hints.en: The guest gives the name on his reservation.
hints.ja: 客が予約名を伝えます。

items.hint: 您好，我用丹尼尔·李的名字订了房。 / The guest gives the name on his reservation. / 客が予約名を伝えます。
